title: Garnix (A Nix CI) is shutting down
summary: Garnix, a free CI service specifically built for Nix/NixOS projects, announced it's shutting down. The maintainer is stepping away citing personal reasons, leaving the Nix community without a popular free CI option for open-source projects.
problem_solved: Provided free continuous integration for Nix-based projects without requiring self-hosted runners
why_valuable: Offered a rare free CI solution tailored for Nix's unique build system, which is expensive to host independently due to its reproducibility requirements
